_comment: Editable position lexicon for Supreme Mathematics. Each key is a digit 0-9. Add or change any field freely — the code reads this at runtime and never hard-codes interpretations.

0.name: Cipher
0.organizing_principle: Full-circle evaluation; holistic impact; community circle
0.instruction: All things exist in a circle. Complete one cycle before beginning the next. Return knowledge to community.

1.name: Knowledge
1.organizing_principle: Needs assessment, community research, understanding root causes, gathering facts
1.instruction: Knowledge is the foundation of all things. Observe before acting. Gather facts. Know thyself first.

2.name: Wisdom
2.pie_root: *weid- (to see, to know by having seen)
2.organizing_principle: Communication strategy, outreach, public narrative, relationship building
2.instruction: Wisdom is knowledge applied through wise word and deed. Speak with intention. Make what you know visible.

3.name: Understanding
3.organizing_principle: Community education, program clarity, shared vision, collective analysis
3.instruction: Understanding is the clear picture born from Knowledge and Wisdom. See what is before deciding what should be.

4.name: Culture / Freedom
4.pie_root: *kwel- (to revolve, move around; to till, cultivate; to dwell)
4.organizing_principle: Organizational culture, self-determination mission, autonomous decision-making
4.instruction: Culture is the way you choose to live. Move in freedom. Refine your way of life toward liberation.

5.name: Power / Refinement
5.organizing_principle: Capacity building, organizational development, leadership growth
5.instruction: Power is truth in action. Refine yourself through disciplined work. Purify what you are building.

6.name: Equality
6.organizing_principle: Equitable practices, mutual benefit structures, horizontal organizing
6.instruction: Equality means treating all according to truth, without hierarchy. Restore balance where there is none.

7.name: God
7.pie_root: *ǵʰew- (to call, invoke) / *dyew- (sky, heaven, the shining one)
key_words: black man with knowledge of self
7.organizing_principle: Leadership development, recognizing community power, divine potential in all
7.instruction: 7 is the most perfect number. Recognize the divine power within yourself and your community. Act from that place.

8.name: Build / Destroy
8.pie_root: *bʰuH- (to grow, become, come into being) / *dʰer- (to hold firmly, support)
8.organizing_principle: Asset-based development, dismantling harmful systems, creating alternatives
8.instruction: Build what elevates life. Destroy what diminishes it. Construction and abolition both serve truth when aimed rightly.

9.name: Born
9.pie_root: *bʰer- (to carry, bear forth; to give birth, bring into existence)
9.organizing_principle: Program outcomes, launching initiatives, manifesting vision, concrete wins
9.instruction: 9 is the highest. What you have built is now born into the world. Bring it forth. Complete the cycle.
